scope: remote production-origin individual browser evidence review for the exact source-built candidate; recorded assertions, not a new browser run or independent transaction replay

G1.02.claim: Native TEST transfer has a successful receipt and observed balance change.
G1.02.basis: Each frozen-origin run finalized its distinct native-transfer receipt. The retained executed driver requires recipient balance 0 before and 10000000 native base units after transfer.

G2.02.claim: Fungible demo supply is 1000000 display units at six decimals, with a successful transfer to a second wallet.
G2.02.basis: checkMint requires 1000000000000 base units and six decimals; recipient account checks require exactly 5000000 base units after a distinct finalized transfer.

G2.03.claim: NFT supply is one at zero decimals, with a successful transfer and verified second-wallet ownership.
G2.03.basis: checkMint requires supply 1 and decimals 0; finalized recipient token account must have amount 1, matching mint and recipient owner.

G2.04.claim: Mint, freeze, metadata pointer and metadata update authorities match the immutable issuance design.
G2.04.basis: Both asset kinds require null mint/freeze/pointer authorities, a pointer to their own mint, and absent or System-address metadata update authority.

G2.08.claim: The remote browser journey contains actual finalized receipts and asset verification.
G2.08.basis: Each frozen profile completed six distinct finalized receipts and two assets with checked mint accounts, recipient token accounts, immutable metadata and artwork. No fixture response supplies these results.

G3.01.claim: A clean browser creates wallets, claims test funds, creates a token, mints an NFT and transfers assets over HTTPS.
G3.01.basis: Each run creates a new browser context and separate payer/recipient pages, then completes all six receipt actions on the fixed production origin. Frozen profiles supply candidate evidence; custom profiles are separately labelled supplemental evidence.
assertions: meme and nft issuance and transfer

G4.03.claim: Current NFT ownership is checked against chain state rather than treating cached gallery ownership as proof.
G4.03.basis: The finalized recipient token-account read verifies the NFT mint, account owner, recipient owner, initialized state and amount 1 before the gallery currentOwner is compared with that recipient.

G7.04.claim: Production frontend, transaction deep links and immutable metadata are anonymously reachable over HTTPS.
G7.04.basis: Clean contexts open the public production frontend and explorer transaction links at both widths; unauthenticated metadata/artwork and frontend entry fetches succeed. Frozen-origin entries match the selected freeze before and after each run.

limitations: This review uses retained passed reports and their checksum-bound executed driver assertions; it does not independently replay chain history.
Raw RPC balance/mint/authority replies were not retained in these reports; numeric and authority conclusions depend on the reviewed driver assertions completing successfully.
The initial custom desktop storage-check failure remains failed and retained; only later fresh passed profiles supply custom evidence.

These eight requirement reviews do not certify complete privacy/log auditing, retry or duplicate-click behavior, restart/recovery, deadline-specific earlier milestones, exhaustive accessibility or physical-device coverage.
Operator access acknowledgment, other individual release requirements and independent mainnet/bridge readiness remain open.
